snippet.title: Merry Crisis // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3975250/Merry_Crisis/

Three loves. One week. Zero chill. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you’re headed?

Developed by 
Monsoon Games
